cohort: Pregnant women <14 weeks' gestation with HbA1c ≥5.9%-6.4% (41-46 mmol/mol) measured at booking, without pre-existing diabetes, recruited from two tertiary referral centres in New Zealand
finding: This feasibility study found lower than expected recruitment rates, particularly among Maori and Pacific women, and significant non-adherence to the allocated treatment protocol, suggesting modifications such as extending the gestation of eligibility and stepped-wedge cluster randomisation are needed for a definitive trial.
